deployCache(bytes).notice: Deploys `0x00 || cache` as immutable runtime code and returns its address. Initcode: PUSH2 size, DUP1, PUSH1 10, RETURNDATASIZE, CODECOPY, RETURNDATASIZE, RETURN — ten bytes returning the payload that follows them. Inert public factory: the payload begins with STOP and can never execute; a core trusts only pointers it stored itself.
